s7-1.title: The Contiguous Prophetic Correlation: Daniel 2 & Daniel 7

steps.title: Daniel 7
points: Ten Horns / Little Horn (Divided Rome & Papacy)
Celestial Court & Kingdom Given to Saints

s7-2.title: The Four Beasts and Their Succession (Daniel 7:4-7)
head: Beast
Characteristics
Historical Fulfillment

cells: 3 ribs in teeth (2020 lesson's identification: could stand for Lydia/Bab/Egypt)
4 wings, 4 heads (History: Diadochi; later three parts)
Iron teeth, 10 horns (History: Germanic tribes of Western Europe)

s7-3.title: The Forensic Profile of the Eleventh Horn (Daniel 7:8, 24-25)

steps.title: Scriptural Criteria
points: Eyes of a man; mouth speaking pomp
Wears out the saints of the Most High
Thinks to change times and laws

steps.title: Historical Fulfillment
points: Rises after the collapse of the Roman Empire, sole power in Rome as of A.D. 538
Heruli (493), Vandals (534); Ostrogoths withdraw in 538, fall about 553
Papal claims: Vicar of Christ; History: this Church claims the universal Bishoprick
Waldenses and Huguenots tried and executed as witches and heretics
Altered Decalogue: Sabbath changed to Sunday

steps.title: Temporal power begins
points: Justinian's decree could slowly become a reality when the siege was lifted in 538
Siege lifted in 538; third horn falls about 553

steps.title: Temporal civil supremacy ends
points: General Berthier captures Pope Pius VI

s7-5.title: The Two Moments of Divine Reckoning

steps.title: 1. The Heavenly Forensic Trial
points: Status of Horn: Still speaking on earth
Verdict: Kingdom awarded to the saints

steps.title: 2. The Terrestrial Execution
points: the kingdom that follows the judgment
Action: Stone strikes image, beast destroyed
Status of Horn: Dominion consumed to the end
Realization: The saints receive the kingdom
